independentVerification.appendixInternalDiscrepancy: Eq. 95 has an apparent real-branch sign error relative to direct eigenvalue algebra and Eqs. 93 and 97; no author-confirmed erratum was found
appendixAdjacentFindings: the symmetric Jacobian makes the complex-eigenvalue branch unreachable
Eq. 96's discriminant is nonnegative rather than strictly positive, with equality at u1=u2=0.3

scaling.denseMode: literal unrestricted recurrent matrix; O(M^2) storage
scaling.factorHistoryMode: unbounded update-factor history with exact Woodbury solves
scaling.factorHistoryInitializationDomain: exact only from K=0 or an explicitly diagonal-plus-low-rank K; generic near-zero dense K is normally full rank
scaling.exactDenseHandoff: materialize unrestricted dense K when M(2r+1) >= M^2
scaling.whyFive: four input susceptibility directions plus one recurrent-state outer product
scaling.finiteRankCompression: model-changing approximation excluded from exact benchmarks
scaling.crossSizeStatus: scientifically motivated project model-family extension, not a paper-specified equivalence
scaling.nonPublicBoundary: Trade secrets and unpublished methods cannot be independently enumerated or ruled out; this project assumes none.
